checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Cup on windowsill with visible rain outside
must.why: Cup on wooden sill, raindrops streak on the glass.
No clear steam visible; only a faint ghostly haze behind the cup at best.
Looks like a photorealistic render, not hand-drawn illustration, though cosy in mood.

must.item: About 6 seconds, no text or audio
must.why: Clip is 6 s, no text seen, silent as specified.

faults.what: Steam is not visible, a core element of the request
Photorealistic rather than the requested illustrated, painterly style
Warm sunny light and a sharp cup; the rain feels weak and the day is not clearly rainy
Cup grows larger across frames (camera push-in); mild drift

summary: A vertical 6-second photoreal clip of a cup on a rainy windowsill came out, but it lacks visible steam and the illustrated style that were requested.
